usdRate.sourceName: National Bank of Cambodia official exchange rate (published by the General Department of Taxation)
usdRate.note: The US dollar is widely used alongside the riel.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: National Bank of Cambodia CPI (via Trading Economics)
inflation_cpi.note: 5.3% year on year in September 2026, up from 4.8% in August; NBC and NIS pages were not reachable, so a secondary source is used.

inflation_projection.sourceName: 5-year CPI average (World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, Trading Economics); NBC has no inflation target
inflation_projection.note: CPI averaged about 2.7% over 2021-2025 but is above 5% in 2026, so we plan with a rounded 3%.

policy_rate.note: The National Bank of Cambodia does not set an official policy rate (Trading Economics uses the average savings deposit rate as a benchmark instead).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Cambodia average saving deposit rate (via Trading Economics)
savings_account_rate.note: Average savings deposit rate, July 2026; secondary source because the NBC site was not reachable.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Published riel fixed deposit rates of a large commercial bank (3 months, interest at maturity)

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Published riel fixed deposit rates of a large commercial bank (12 months, interest at maturity)

dps_rate.note: Banks sell monthly recurring savings plans in riel and dollars, but we could not read a current published rate page (bank pages blocked).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST)

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Cambodia has no government savings certificate or retail savings bond; government bonds are auctioned on the NBC platform (see tbond rates).

tbill_91d_rate.note: Cambodia issues no 91-day treasury bills; the shortest government bond is 1 year (2.75% average coupon in 2025).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Cambodia Annual Report 2025, average winning bid yield on 5-year government bonds (via Vietstock / Khmer Times)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Average coupon 4.21%, average winning yield 4.50% in 2025.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: National Bank of Cambodia Annual Report 2025, average coupon on 10-year government bonds (via Vietstock / Khmer Times)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Average coupon 4.60% in 2025; no yield published, coupons are set at auction.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Withholding tax note on a large bank's fixed deposit page (Cambodian Law on Taxation)
tax_bank_interest.note: 6% final withholding on fixed deposit interest for residents; 4% on savings accounts; 14% for non-residents.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Ministry of Economy and Finance Notification 007 (21 July 2026) on tax incentives for 2026 government securities (DFDL summary)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No savings certificate exists; for government securities issued in 2026 withholding on interest is cut from 6% to 3% and the interest is exempt from tax on income.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Cambodia Investment Review, AMRO report on bank liquidity (July 2026)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: No formal deposit insurance scheme exists in Cambodia (AMRO also noted this in 2024).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: NBC's 18% a year cap (Prakas B7-017-109, 2017) covers microfinance lenders only; we found no cap or published typical rate for bank credit cards.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Cambodia Securities Exchange record; bank deposit rates
equity_return_low.note: The local exchange is small and illiquid with a weak record since its 2018 high, so the low case is zero in riel terms.

equity_return_base.sourceName: After-tax 1-year deposit 3.85% plus a modest premium
equity_return_base.note: Weak, thin local market: base set only about 2.5 points above the after-tax 1-year deposit rate, well under the 4-point limit.

equity_return_high.sourceName: After-tax deposit rate plus a full equity premium
equity_return_high.note: High case if listings deepen and regional equity returns are achieved.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; managed KHR/USD rate (NBC official rate via GDT)
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for a decade; the riel is held near 4,000-4,100 per dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; managed KHR/USD rate (NBC official rate via GDT)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% with little expected riel depreciation against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; managed KHR/USD rate (NBC official rate via GDT)
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Riel fixed deposit rates after 6% withholding
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case near the after-tax 3-month deposit rate (2.5%). Safe KHR rates: 3-month deposit 2.7%, 1-year 4.1% at a large bank (6% withholding tax on fixed deposits), 5-year government bond yield 4.5% (2025 average, 3% withholding for 2026 issues).

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Riel fixed deposit rates after 6% withholding
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case at the after-tax 1-year deposit rate (4.1% x 0.94). Safe KHR rates: 3-month deposit 2.7%, 1-year 4.1% at a large bank (6% withholding tax on fixed deposits), 5-year government bond yield 4.5% (2025 average, 3% withholding for 2026 issues).

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case near the after-tax 5- to 10-year government bond yield. Safe KHR rates: 3-month deposit 2.7%, 1-year 4.1% at a large bank (6% withholding tax on fixed deposits), 5-year government bond yield 4.5% (2025 average, 3% withholding for 2026 issues).

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Insurance Regulator of Cambodia publishes premiums and claims totals but we found no claim settlement ratio.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but we found no published premium rates or credible premium guide in riel.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates or guides found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: NBC CPI health sub-index (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_health.note: Health CPI is flat in 2026, but with 61% of health spending out of pocket and private care growing, we plan 2 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: NBC CPI education sub-index (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_education.note: The education index (186.9, Sep 2026) has risen much faster than the headline CPI over time, so we plan 2 points above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age; secondary source because the WHO GHO API was unavailable.

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant (via populationpyramid.net); World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 9.9 in 2025 (World Bank), 13.3 in 2040 and 24.0 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Sub-decree 32 on the Social Security Scheme on Pension (NSSF), Article 13 (unofficial translation)
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension from age 60 with at least 12 months of contributions; same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Open Development Cambodia, Ministry of Civil Service Letter 5420 (25 Nov 2019)
retirement_age_government.note: All civil servants retire at 60 regardless of framework (previously 55, 58 or 60).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Riel fixed deposit rates after 6% withholding
retirement_return_low.note: Low case near the after-tax 3-month deposit rate. Safe KHR rates: 3-month deposit 2.7%, 1-year 4.1% at a large bank (6% withholding tax on fixed deposits), 5-year government bond yield 4.5% (2025 average, 3% withholding for 2026 issues).

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Riel fixed deposit rates after 6% withholding
retirement_return_base.note: Base case just under the after-tax 1-year deposit rate (3.85%). Safe KHR rates: 3-month deposit 2.7%, 1-year 4.1% at a large bank (6% withholding tax on fixed deposits), 5-year government bond yield 4.5% (2025 average, 3% withholding for 2026 issues).

retirement_return_high.note: High case near after-tax longer government bond yields. Safe KHR rates: 3-month deposit 2.7%, 1-year 4.1% at a large bank (6% withholding tax on fixed deposits), 5-year government bond yield 4.5% (2025 average, 3% withholding for 2026 issues).

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of riel deposits, government bonds and equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% equity at the low case, 60% deposits and bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of riel deposits, government bonds and equity
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half equity at 6.5% and half deposits/bonds near 3.9%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of riel deposits, government bonds and equity
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% equity at the high case and 40% bonds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No universal social pension; poor elderly in IDPoor households get a cash transfer under the Family Package of social assistance, but we could not find the current amount.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Elderly cash transfer is part of the Family Package for IDPoor (means-tested) households; current age rules and amounts not found.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Labour Ministry Prakas 443 (2018) and MLVT instruction on seniority indemnity (Tilleke & Gibbins summary)
gratuity_rule.note: Seniority indemnity of 15 days of average wages and benefits a year, paid as 7.5 days each June and December; a month counts as 26 working days.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Sub-decree 32 on the Social Security Scheme on Pension (NSSF), unofficial translation
public_pension_scheme.note: NSSF pension for workers under the Labour Law (from Oct 2022): 4% of wages (2% employer, 2% employee) for the first 5 years, then stepping up; accrual 1.75% a year for the first 15 years and 1.25% after; benefits adjusted yearly by the official CPI.

fdr_3m.localName: ប្រាក់បញ្ញើមានកាលកំណត់

fdr_1y.localName: ប្រាក់បញ្ញើមានកាលកំណត់

dps.localName: គណនីសន្សំប្រចាំខែ
dps.note: Offered by some banks in riel and dollars; no published average rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond.

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bills; shortest government bond is 1 year.

tbond_5y.localName: មូលបត្របំណុលរដ្ឋ
tbond_5y.note: Riel government bonds (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15 years) are auctioned by the Ministry of Economy and Finance on the NBC platform.

tbond_10y.localName: មូលបត្របំណុលរដ្ឋ
tbond_10y.note: Auctioned on the NBC platform; secondary market is thin.

equity_fund.localName: មូលនិធិវិនិយោគរួម
equity_fund.note: Few licensed retail funds; the local stock exchange is small.

gold.note: Physical gold is widely bought at markets and gold shops.

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Regulator of Cambodia (IRC)
insuranceComplaints.note: Complaints about insurers go to the regulator.

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security Fund (NSSF), pension scheme

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (Health Equity Fund for poor households; NSSF health care for workers)

statistics.name: National Institute of Statistics (NIS), Ministry of Planning
